house_style: Sophisticated editorial soft oil painting for older students. Warm directional lamplight from upper left, dark walnut, oxidized brass, cream paper, rich painterly material detail, subtle canvas grain. Museum-quality still life, restrained and atmospheric. No text, letters, numbers, logos, people, faces or hands.

assets.name: hearing-room
assets.prompt: A long polished wooden hearing table seen from the front in a wood-paneled room, five empty leather chairs behind it, five blank brass nameplates standing on the table, a green-shaded lamp at each end. Symmetrical wide composition, warm lamplight from upper left, beautiful walnut grain and brass reflections. The upper middle is quiet dark wood for a sentence card overlay; lower third is the table front. Empty room, no writing anywhere.

assets.name: papers
assets.prompt: A neat upright stack of blank ivory paper held by a small black steel binder clip with silver wire handles. Fine layered paper edges, shallow deckle texture, a gently turned lower corner, subtle warm shadows between sheets. Front view, complete object centered with generous margins. Sophisticated soft oil still life, warm lamplight from upper left, cream and amber palette, restrained painted detail matching polished brass and walnut. The top sheet stays blank for a code-drawn check. Isolated on flat pure magenta #FF00FF. No floor, no external cast shadow, no writing, no people.
